target.output: append-only losing claim collision receipts plus progress/control-room projection

problem: Losing exclusive claim races are only visible in ephemeral host errors; no durable loser receipt/event exists, so collision recovery metrics and the 50-worker verifier cannot reconstruct how many races were safely lost and reallocated.
acceptance: Each losing exclusive create-if-absent attempt can append an immutable collision receipt referencing opportunity, worker, attempted claim and observed host/winner evidence without modifying the winner.
Collision receipts feed metrics/control-room verification with replay-safe deduplication.
Instrumentation explicitly distinguishes unobserved historical collisions from measured zero collisions.
No collision receipt grants execution, Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.
title: Durable losing-claim collision receipts
mission: Add an append-only receipt path for workers that lose an exclusive claim race, and project those receipts into metrics/control-room verification so the canary can measure safe collision recovery rather than infer zero from missing evidence. Preserve the winning claim unchanged and treat receipts as observability only.

information_gain.reason: The current durable model records winners but not losing claim attempts; without loser receipts the collision denominator cannot be reconstructed from repository evidence.

regression_prevention.reason: The verification contract requires duplicate-claim collision recovery metrics, while the progress-event vocabulary currently has CLAIM_ACQUIRED but no lost-race event.

unblock_value.reason: The 50-worker stress verifier is explicitly required to measure collision/duplication behavior; durable loser evidence makes that measurement auditable instead of dependent on surviving chats.

fail_if: a losing-race receipt can alter or supersede the winning claim
replay of the same host collision is counted more than once
absence of pre-instrumentation receipts is reported as measured zero collisions
collision receipts are treated as execution authority or completion evidence
falsification.pass_if: In a controlled exclusive-claim race, exactly one winning claim remains immutable, each instrumented loser can persist a deduplicated append-only collision receipt, and a fresh verifier can reconstruct measured collisions and safe reallocations from durable state alone.
